done_with_evidence: Buddy pairs are a unit of work (sentinels7.gd plan()/_pairs): persistent two-man teams S.pr (mutual, kept through rest, QRF turn-out and re-plans, erased when a man is gone). When the board takes a man for a paired job (non-care, not rest/standto, slots>=2) it takes his partner too; a job with one free slot (or a non-paired job) adds tactics.pair_split_pen (1000) to a man who has an available partner, so a team is split only when nobody else fits. _pairs pairs S.pr teams first.

Drag spot (_drag_spot, used by _casualty_drill and _care_under_fire): best cover within drag_r away from the threat; if there is none (man down in the open field) he is dragged up to tactics.drag_far (8, PROVISIONAL) away from the threat or back towards the facility to real cover. Playtest before: casualty dragged to cover 0.00 in the open; after: cover 0.75 at the foot of a tower.

test_tactics_drill: the drill's man goes down during the rush (t>=150, alarm, moving, gait>=2, cover<open_v, buddy within 2*bound_len+1); the old after-the-fight pick is only the fallback; checks unchanged (plus a check that the casualty still exists).
